metadata_evidence.supports: Carbon stocks Mg C per hectare; biodiversity and carbon/soil surveys in 2010-2011; species richness groups.
Joined table used as model input; prepared output preserves unscaled values.

decisions: One Item covers both descriptions because their primary asset is the same joined table. Select only the five site keys/classes, seven richness fields and four carbon fields; retain the complete original and the separate forest-species and regional carbon files. No coordinate join or spatial inference.
limitations: Site tables remain nonspatial; coordinates require a verified join and CRS.
Missing values remain NA. Site aggregates do not replace individual observations.

land_cover.SFold: old secondary forest, older than 20 years

forest_species_definition: Species recorded at least once at a primary forest site.
